messages:
alex: deploybot alerted: prod-embeds service spike starting ~10:05 UTC, error-rate ~5% on v2.3.1. I ran a quick diff, looks like tokenizer edge-case. proposing hotfix v2.3.2 and a small schema-safe rollback plan. Requesting expedited approval during today's 10:30-11:00 change window.
priya: can you paste the rollback criteria and impact matrix? we need clear cutoffs (p95 latency, error %) before i +1.
alex: rollback criteria: if canary error-rate >2% after 10m or p95 latency regresses >150ms vs baseline -> immediate rollback. impact matrix in shorthand: users:0.3% degraded, api-surface: embeddings only, db: no schema changes.
lisa: drop release notes link? product needs the brief for the change log. also prefer we pin the canary image tag.
alex: release notes draft: https://redwood.in/release/drafts/2.3.2 — tiny tokenizer fix, adds defensive check for empty tokens. will pin tag to ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.2-hotfix.
marco: on pinning: i can push an image tag and update the deploy manifest. also propose staging smoke for 5m then canary 10% traffic -> 30m monitor. if canary ok, shift to 100% with 5m ramp steps.
deploybot: @channel deploy request received: emb-prod v2.3.2 (image: ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.2-hotfix). change window OK (10:30-11:00). canary config: 10% for 20m. runbook: /runbooks/embeds-hotfix.
oncall-sre: metrics snapshot (10:08): errors 4.9% (last 15m), p95 210ms, tokens/s normal. i'll keep eyes on logs. if error-rate climbs >6% escalate to infra.
priya: reading rollout plan + runbook. i approve expedited release under the stated rollback criteria. :thumbsup:
lisa: approved. pinned image please and add a one-liner to release notes: "Fix tokenization crash for specific inputs; reduces embed failures."
marco: i've pushed the tag and updated the manifest. starting staging smoke now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeds-staging && kubectl -n staging wait --for=condition=available deploy/embeds-staging --timeout=120s`
deploybot: staging smoke complete: healthy pods 3/3, basic requests ok. initiating canary: 10% traffic.
oncall-sre: canary metrics (10:45): errors down to 1.1%, p95 185ms. no new tails in Sentry.
alex: thanks team. i'm giving final signoff to proceed to ramp if oncall is happy.
priya: proceed to 50% then 100% per ramp steps. i'll watch.
deploybot: canary passed checks. ramping to 50% traffic now.
oncall-sre: 50% at 10:52: errors steady 0.9%, p95 178ms. all green.
deploybot: ramp complete: 100% traffic at 10:58. deployment finished.
alex: marking this hotfix as expedited and adding release note to the changelog. thanks for the fast turnaround :rocket:
lisa: will follow up with docs refresh. closing thread after 1hr post-deploy.
priya: noted. leaving monitoring for 60m. will reopen if anything spikes.
deploybot: deploy event: emb-prod v2.3.2 succeeded. link: https://deploys.redwood.dev/embeds/1777771234
